about_the_game:
Main features

  • Fast-paced top-down action gameplay

  • Twin-stick shooter

  • Local co-op with AI assistants

  • Character and weapon upgrades

  • More than 50 different enemies

  • 20 levels in 4 different worlds

Cyber Siege

In the year 2347, the four interconnected worlds of the Kepler-186 system faced an unprecedented threat: the Voidborn, an interdimensional race of energy beings intent on draining their life force. The only defense against this cosmic terror are two advanced defense mechs, identical in their core programming but specialized through modular attachments. Their AI cores work in perfect synergy, anticipating each other's moves.

The invasion unfolds across distinctly themed worlds:

World 1: Azure Labyrinths: The Voidborn's initial incursion into Veridia hasn't touched the surface yet. Instead, they've infested a vast network of corridors bathed in a weird, pale blue light. Sentinel and Interceptor are deployed into these Azure Labyrinths to eliminate the initial Voidborn presence and secure critical infrastructure. They face energy constructs and learn the fundamental weaknesses of their ethereal enemies within the claustrophobic, glowing tunnels.

World 2: Arachnid Depths: The invasion of Crystalia takes a darker turn. Deep within its crystalline caverns, a pre-existing ecosystem of giant, bioluminescent spiders – both organic and terrifyingly advanced robotic versions – has been corrupted and amplified by the Voidborn energy. In these Arachnid Depths, Sentinel and Interceptor must navigate shadowy tunnels and crystalline outcroppings, battling hordes of these mutated arachnids, utilizing light and sonic weaponry to disorient and destroy them in the oppressive darkness.

World 3: Xylos - The Indigo Expanse: The third world, Xylos, is an alien planet with a strange, blue-tinged atmosphere and bizarre, bioluminescent flora. The Voidborn have established a foothold across its open, alien landscapes – the Indigo Expanse. Sentinel and Interceptor must adapt to the strange gravity and alien lifeforms, facing Voidborn units that blend with the environment and utilizing long-range weaponry and tactical positioning to overcome them in the vast, blue-lit wilderness.

World 4: The Core Nexus: The final confrontation takes place on Technos, within the Voidborn's central command structure – the Core Nexus. This is a heavily fortified, technologically advanced environment filled with intricate machinery, energy conduits, and powerful defense systems now controlled by the Voidborn. Sentinel and Interceptor must utilize all their accumulated upgrades and strategic coordination to penetrate the layers of defenses and confront the Voidborn leader in a final, desperate battle for the fate of the Kepler-186 system within this ultimate technical gauntlet.

Throughout their mission, players will strategically customize Sentinel and Interceptor's loadouts to best suit the challenges of each unique world. The key to survival lies in understanding the environments, exploiting enemy weaknesses, and harnessing the synchronized power of these two adaptable mechs.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 64-bit 
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz Intel or AMD
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2GB AMD R9 285 (GCN 3rd Generation), 2GB Nvidia GTX 680 
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 64-bit 
  • Processor: Zen 2 4c/8t, 2.4-3.5GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8GB AMD Radeon RX 480, 8GB Nvidia GTX 1080 
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Cyber Siege is a fast-paced twin-stick shooter with pure gameplay. Play solo or in local co-op with AI assistants. Upgrade your character and weapons as you fight 50+ enemy types across 20 levels in 4 distinct worlds.
